<issue>
Left indent values are inverted when setting paragraph format

#### Description

When setting the `left_indent` property on a paragraph format, the value gets inverted (negated). Setting a positive indent value results in a negative indent being applied, and vice versa.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Create a document and add a paragraph
doc = Document()
paragraph = doc.add_paragraph("This is a test paragraph")

# Try to set left indent to 1 inch
paragraph.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(1)

# The actual indent applied will be -1 inch instead of +1 inch
print(f"Expected: positive indent")
print(f"Actual: negative indent applied")
```

The issue affects any attempt to set left indentation on paragraphs, causing text to be indented in the opposite direction from what's intended.
</issue>
